snippet.title: The Deconsecration Initiative - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Deconsecration Initiative is a short incremental game about building a machine to kill a god. Fire your laser, collect the shards and grow your base. The god will corrupt your workers into slugs, crystal trees and worse. Put them to work anyway.

Play the free playtest in your browser on itch.io now: https://gwilym.itch.io/the-deconsecration-initiative

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4753470/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=channel&utm_content=gameplay_trailer
